record.question: The trade winds blow in which direction?
record.explanation: Answer C: east to west. Trade winds generally blow from the east toward the west in both hemispheres. Reference: https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/tradewinds.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
